items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 14:1
items.html: Daat is comprised of five Hassadim and five Gevurot; and if the five Hassadim do not illuminate in it in wholeness, it is called a light Daat — that is, that it lacks wholeness. (p. 619, Item 25)
